candidate_choice_reason: The fixed secondary P02 model is the best of its six development models. Selecting it here creates a new prospective candidate and does not change TT007's primary result.
kernel_definition: Gaussian RBF, squared Euclidean distance divided by feature count; bandwidth is training-pair median positive distance times multiplier squared; intercept is training mean target, fit centered targets with K + n*ridge*I, clip final predictions to [0,1].
packet_kernel_definition: Mean of expression/unsigned RBF and raw signed outgoing-packet RBF, each with its own training-only scaling and bandwidth.
baseline_selection: Minimum equal-block held-out Brier on eight development blocks, then lexicographic model id. The simple expression/history baseline is retained regardless of selection.
primary_information_boundary: Current expression, history, unsigned access versus the same channels plus signed transfer. Raw-packet rival is a separate full-record challenge; all use the same development labels and no test labels.
margin_rationale: Operational threshold of about 2.35% of the simple baseline's development Brier loss; a modest nonzero predictive improvement required to justify the extra record diagnostic. It is not a physical energy or fitness threshold.
variance_sensitivity: Report plug-in block variance and 95% normal-theory upper standard-deviation sensitivity from eight exposed blocks; neither is a power guarantee.
launch_gate: Positive development excess above the practical margin against the selected expression rival and simple expression/history, with an 80% plug-in planning sample within the fixed maximum; otherwise retain an informative design failure without generating test outcomes.
prospective_scope: New independent blocks within the same apparatus, history mixture and endpoint; not cross-apparatus RDT confirmation.
